question.text: What is the plot of the movie The 400 Blows?

results.hint: François Truffaut drew partly on his own unhappy childhood when creating the film’s central character.

question.text: Which author wrote 'The Tempest'?

question.text: From which plant is Rum made?

question.text: Which organs do most fish use to breathe underwater?
